intent: Define and implement a repository-wide policy for accessible production text when authoritative source paint falls below WCAG 2.2 contrast thresholds, resolve the Field-family and compact Modal P1 deviations, and deliver an unmerged merge-ready PR.

provenance.ref: The user authorized autonomous execution of the recommended accessibility-versus-fidelity PR through merge readiness and required CodeRabbit as the last review step.
AGENTS.md and docs/source-of-truth.md keep shlz-design-source/raw/svg authoritative and read-only while requiring repository decisions and deviations to remain explicit.
Autonomous execution delegates the policy choice; active production text will meet WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 even when that requires an explicit repository override of source paint.
Autonomous execution delegates implementation design; shared semantic accessible text tokens will concentrate the override instead of component-local recoloring.

Issues #13 and #25 plus docs/component-audits/select.json and modal.json identify the Field-family and compact Modal P1 deviations; Status remains a separately recorded P3 source-paint finding unless policy application proves it in scope.
AGENTS.md and docs/agent-execution.md require a clean origin/main task branch, immutable receipts, validation, independent review, an unmerged PR, and user-owned merge.
